environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. Container runs as root with /app/extracted mounted as an EFS volume shared with other services. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 directly to the target group. No request inspection or filtering is applied at any layer. The unzipper package version is 0.10.11.

config.storage: EFS mount at /app/extracted shared across services
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
